chosen.premise: An itchy nose during sleep is Drowzee standing over your pillow and eating your dream through your nostrils.
chosen.hook: That itchy nose might not be allergies—it might be Drowzee.
chosen.visualIdea: Follow an overnight itch clue from the sleeper’s nose to Drowzee hovering above the pillow.
chosen.note: A bizarre, concrete, unmistakably Drowzee-specific warning backed almost verbatim by multiple entries; it creates an immediate mystery and a clear visual reveal.

candidates.premise: An itchy nose during sleep is Drowzee standing over your pillow and eating your dream through your nostrils.
candidates.hook: That itchy nose might not be allergies—it might be Drowzee.
candidates.visualIdea: Follow an overnight itch clue from the sleeper’s nose to Drowzee hovering above the pillow.
candidates.note: A bizarre, concrete, unmistakably Drowzee-specific warning backed almost verbatim by multiple entries; it creates an immediate mystery and a clear visual reveal.

candidates.premise: Drowzee eats dreams, but bad dreams taste sour and can make it sick.
candidates.hook: Drowzee is a dream eater with a very specific food allergy.
candidates.visualIdea: Show colorful dreams as sweet treats and bad dreams as sour, rejected food.
candidates.note: A highly Drowzee-specific food mechanic, directly supported by multiple Pokédex entries; the sourness and sickness make it especially visual.

candidates.premise: One nose twitch lets Drowzee locate sleepers and identify what they are dreaming about.
candidates.hook: Drowzee can find your bed and read your dream with its nose.
candidates.visualIdea: A nose-twitch pulse scans a town, highlighting sleeping people and their dreams.
candidates.note: Excellent visual premise and genuinely surprising, but “one nose twitch” overstates the cited entry, which only says that nose-twitching enables the ability.

candidates.premise: Drowzee remembers every dream it eats and may replay its favorites for trusted friends.
candidates.hook: Drowzee doesn’t just eat dreams—it keeps an entire memory archive.
candidates.visualIdea: Dream scenes get stored as glowing memory reels, then projected for a friend.
candidates.note: The memory-archive concept is strongly supported and offers great visuals, though “trusted friends” and “favorites” slightly paraphrase the source’s wording about friends and delicious dreams.

candidates.premise: Drowzee rarely eats adults' dreams because children's dreams are tastier.
candidates.hook: Drowzee has a target demographic: children’s dreams.
candidates.visualIdea: Contrast an adult's dream plate with a child's colorful dream buffet.
candidates.note: The child-versus-adult preference is strange and well supported, but the angle is less concrete than the sour-dream mechanic and risks feeling uncomfortable without careful framing.

candidates.premise: Drowzee stays a dream-eating Psychic Pokémon until level 26, when it evolves into Hypno.
candidates.hook: At level 26, Drowzee’s dream-eating career changes form.
candidates.visualIdea: A level counter climbs to 26, then Drowzee’s silhouette transforms into Hypno.
candidates.note: The level-26 transformation is precise and easy to animate, but level-based evolution is a generic Pokémon angle and is less surprising than Drowzee’s dream lore.

rounds.request: None; itchy-nose-warning is strong enough. Stronger alternatives would need an equally concrete, canon-backed Drowzee-specific rule with a sharper visual reveal and less paraphrased wording.
